name: SimSpot Customer Discovery
task: Handle an inbound customer-discovery conversation in SimSpot. Search for an existing or duplicate contact before writing, ask the documented discovery topics rather than guessing, confirm the latest requirements, respect the customer's data-consent scope, update the correct contact, create one appropriate follow-up, and send an honest summary with open questions and next steps. Verify every write before claiming completion.
completion: Return a concise account of confirmed facts, unresolved questions, the contact selected after duplicate checking, consent handling, verified SimSpot changes and the follow-up created. Do not claim a decision-maker, budget, consent or stable requirement that the customer did not confirm.
